mismatching declared dimensions with previous-generation rollback

pixelEquivalence.algorithm: SHA-256 over row-major 8-bit non-premultiplied RGBA pixels; width/height recorded separately

localObservations.scope: Fresh Go processes on warm local filesystem/cache; ordinary loopback HTTP only; no browser, provider or isolated CPU/load conditions.
localObservations.startWindow: Before fixture construction to real Go health response; includes artifact SHA-256 reads, temporary directory/source-listener setup, process spawn, startup PNG production/validation and readiness polling.
localObservations.requestWindow: Client request creation to complete identity PNG body over a new TCP connection (agent:false); includes Node/network/Go response work.
limitations: Five processes and 25 PNG requests per SDK are descriptive observations, not tail/load statistics.
No matched no-producer control isolates PNG startup cost.
No cold filesystem, RSS/CPU/allocation/CLS measurement or hosted serverless qualification.
No performance release threshold or SDK speed comparison is inferred.

ci.nativeContainerContract: 24 asset cases per SDK in a source-free scratch container

attempts: The first report assembler incorrectly required equal encoded PNG byte totals across SDKs. Exact artifacts instead measure 32159 PNG bytes on Go 1.27.3 and 10001 on Go 1.24.13, with 112 alt-text bytes in either case. Both SDK decoders independently produce identical NRGBA8 pixel hashes for both encodings; the report now preserves separate encoded identities.

Initial root assertions incorrectly scanned the whole HTML including the still-public handler inventory. They now inspect only the head. A subsequent navigation assertion omitted legacy Envelope.Meta; it now checks head plus the separately transported legacy map. These assertion failures did not show incorrect production override/clear behavior.
One new export-test syntax typo was corrected before production builds. The corrected focused tests and complete two-SDK race/vet runs pass.
limitations: Local Lambda Runtime API adapters are not hosted AWS/serverless execution; user selected local-machine qualification for now.
Only Linux desktop system Chromium was run locally. Defined Firefox/WebKit/touch and remote CI matrices remain pending.
The fixed app-root PNG conventions do not implement nested precedence, JPEG/GIF variants, multiple generated image IDs, request-dependent static producers or build-only PNG precomputation.
Original public cards use the existing ASCII bitmap face; this does not establish CSS/HTML/shaping/ImageResponse/Satori compatibility or general font/script quality.
Plain static hosting controls cache/MIME/CORS/ETag headers; tests use the existing no-cache file server, without synthetic framework validators. CDN/crawler behavior remains unqualified.

Startup and loopback timings include fixture/client work and warm local caches, lack a matched no-producer control and are not production cold-start/load/RSS/CPU/latency evidence or SDK speed comparisons.
The new report is not an independent security audit, decoder/encoder fuzz campaign, soak/recovery or provider-quota qualification.
Current Go 1.27.3 demo exceeds existing raw/Go gzip-9 WASM budgets. No budget increase or waiver; historical minimum-SDK sizing remains its own source checkpoint.
All 79 capabilities and G01-G11 are retained in docs/PARITY.md. No acceptance, gate closure or full parity/maturity claim.
The example uses illustrative public origins and explicit external override image URLs. Replace them before deployment; the framework does not fetch/publish arbitrary external metadata images.
